thesis: Model choice matters. The durable advantage is orchestration, context, trusted action, recovery, and evaluation.
boundary: A production multi-agent system from model access through governed action and operational evidence.

nodes.label: Model gateway
nodes.description: Routes each task to an appropriate model or provider by capability, risk, latency, cost, and modality.

nodes.label: Agent control plane
nodes.description: Declares roles, instructions, routing, handoffs, budgets, permissions, and stop conditions.

nodes.label: Multi-agent workshop
nodes.description: A supervisor, specialists, and reviewer collaborate through explicit contracts and bounded delegation.

nodes.label: Context and memory
nodes.description: Retrieves trusted context and persists scoped working and durable memory.

nodes.label: Capability mesh
nodes.description: Exposes tools, APIs, data, code, and retrieval through typed, least-privilege contracts.

nodes.label: Durable runtime
nodes.description: Owns state, retries, checkpoints, queues, idempotency, fallback, and compensation.

nodes.label: Trust and human approval
nodes.description: Applies identity, policy, scoped permissions, safety checks, approval gates, and audit evidence.

nodes.label: Evals and observability
nodes.description: Measures traces, quality, cost, latency, failures, regressions, and incidents.

edges.condition: The control plane requests a model route for a declared task.
Delegation fits the task and remains within the active budget and policy.
Retrieved context passes provenance and access checks.
A typed tool contract and scoped permission are available.
Every long-running operation records state and recovery behavior.
High-impact or irreversible actions require an explicit gate.
Every run emits trace, quality, cost, latency, and failure evidence.
Only reviewed evidence changes prompts, routes, tools, policies, or models.

lenses.providers: Model and agent-service ecosystems accessed through the gateway; not a ranking.
lenses.protocols: MCP connects tools and context; A2A connects independent agents.
lenses.runtimes: Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, and CrewAI express workflows, state, durability, memory, human control, and observability.
